verdict_rule: FALSIFIED if any counterexample; else NOT_ESTABLISHED; PROVEN only from a proof of Q_cert,i <= Q_i(omega) for all omega in Omega, which a bounded search cannot supply
does_not_transfer_to: v2 absolute-sensory / zero-order fish quality model

assumptions.claim: every v1 quality update is q <- min(q, q*exp(-k*dt)); no other factor or additive term
assumptions.falsified_by: an update path that multiplies/divides/adds something else

assumptions.claim: the temperature driving the rate never exceeds max(hard_upper[class], ambient) on Omega
assumptions.falsified_by: instrumenting the rate temperature on real runs and finding a value above the bound (see F-a door warming)

assumptions.claim: k(class, T) is non-decreasing in T
assumptions.falsified_by: a non-monotone rate over the admissible temperature range

assumptions.claim: the in-cargo time from now to delivery never exceeds tw_end[0] - now on Omega
assumptions.evidence_anchor: depot_return_violation in the terminal gate; certify_route return check
assumptions.falsified_by: an Omega-member trajectory delivering after tw_end[0] (see F-b/F-c)

assumptions.claim: Omega is DEFINED by the hard gates, so the bound is conditional on them
assumptions.falsified_by: relaxing a hard gate without re-deriving T^max / tau^max -- a qualification change, not an empirical one

L-departure-monotone.claim: a later admissible departure never yields HIGHER delivered quality, so the worst case over Omega-for-a-fixed-plan is the latest admissible departure
L-departure-monotone.measured: 1-D admissible-departure sweep on a real decision point: the last grid point (delay ~5.99 h) delivered quality 0.997234 while delays 0..~5.2 h all delivered 0.997133 -- quality INCREASED with the delay
L-departure-monotone.why: delaying the departure can remove a wait so the vehicle arrives exactly at `tw_start`; because service_start = max(arrive, tw_start), the downstream schedule stops moving while pre-departure idle time disappears, SHORTENING the in-cargo time of later-picked lots
L-departure-monotone.consequence: the tight "worst case = latest feasible departure" design MAY NOT be used; the static T/tau analytic bound is the surviving candidate

fixed_by_production_configuration.active_zone_mask: (True,)*zones -- strict_online_env._coldchain_active_mask() never disables a zone in this configuration, so the uncooled drift branch is out of Omega
fixed_by_production_configuration.quality_model: v1 QualityConfig (first-order, per-class Arrhenius rate, ratio thresholds)
fixed_by_production_configuration.precool_branch: lot.precooled = thermal.precooled and temp_class >= precool_min_temp_class (coldchain_state.py:261-262); both branches are IN Omega and A2 covers both via the ambient widening

membership_conditions.thermal: temperature_hard_feasible == True (no segment temperature outside hard_temperature_bounds_c; coldchain_evaluator.py:358)
membership_conditions.time_windows: every arrival <= tw_end; time windows are only widened by waiting at tw_start, never by departing before the previous service finished
membership_conditions.capacity: cumulative load <= shared_vehicle_capacity at every pickup
membership_conditions.commitment: a committed leg is never revoked; an order is picked exactly once
membership_conditions.ordering: waiting is only "do not dispatch" (mutable_suffix == []) and may delay a later departure, but may not reorder the plan suffix; the plan suffix order is preserved in Omega
membership_conditions.clock: time never moves backwards (_advance_coldchain_to raises otherwise)
membership_conditions.horizon: the run stops at the instance horizon; a trajectory that needs _force_return_all to return after tw_end[0] is NOT in Omega (see F-b)

degrees_of_freedom_within_Omega: the number and length of WAIT stretches before dispatch (bounded by booking_horizon)
the exact departure time per leg inside the gap left by the previous service finish and the next tw_end
the realised door events (one per pickup) and the number of remaining pickups
the realised cooling duty, hence the actual per-segment zone temperatures
